_comment: Machine-readable facts for this project. Every entry must carry how it was established. If a fact is listed as 'measured' the measurement exists in NOTES.md or docs/. Anything not here should be re-measured, not remembered. This file exists because the session was compacted twice and the same facts (menu keys, room meaning, mouse calibration) were re-derived several times.

control_files.state: /tmp/nid_state_<id>.txt  (them_x them_y me_x me_y have154 have242 - NOTE names are unreliable, see player_identity)
control_files.instances: /tmp/nid_insts_<id>.txt  (id object_index x y, one line per instance)
control_files.click: /tmp/nid_click_<id>.txt  (window-content x y, posts a real CGEvent click)
control_files.DANGER_room_cmd: /tmp/nid_room_<id>.txt is a room_goto COMMAND; a stale value there kills the game ('Game ended before loading first room')

launch_env_required.NID_THREAD: 1 - without it the hook's probe thread never starts, so there are no state files at all
launch_env_required.NID_SHOW: 1 - keeps the window on screen; MEASURED 120-320 fps visible vs ~24-30 fps parked
launch_env_required.NID_NICE: unset by default; setting it applies nice 19 + background QoS, which MEASURED 4x slower

rooms.source: decompiled from Contents/Resources/game.ios by a pi subagent; table in docs/ROOM_NAMES.md; 82 rooms
rooms.arenas: 26-77 excluding 69 and 78 (castle / mines / sky / wilds / cemetery sections)
rooms.note: the title screen's attract demo runs INSIDE an arena room (29 rCastleCenter), so room index alone cannot distinguish demo from match

keys.W: does NOT move the main menu

menu.structure: the list SCROLLS under a FIXED highlight bar; the bar sits at the same screen position regardless of selected row
menu.highlight_bar_capture: in a 1920x1256 capture of a 960x628 window the bar spans image y 836-886; grey value 30 at x=0.33W
menu.consequence: the selected row can only be identified by the TEXT under the bar (band template matching, see nav3.py), never by a coordinate
menu.danger: pressing Enter inside OPTIONS cycles the LANGUAGE row: measured flips to French and then Chinese
menu.verified_path: fresh launch -> Enter -> (S x5 from MULTIPLAYER) -> Enter -> S -> Enter -> Enter -> S -> Enter -> Enter => room 2 -> 17 -> 29

player_identity.source: measured by holding D/A and diffing every instance (session 220)
player_identity.finding: the object index of the player DIFFERS BY ROOM: object 154 answered in one arena (D +64, A -25), object 244 in another; the other object did not move at all
player_identity.consequence: no fixed me/them slot mapping is correct; the authoritative fighter is the one that RESPONDS to D -> right and A -> left (bind_by_response)
player_identity.hook_labels: the state file's first pair (them_*) comes from object 154, the second (me_*) from object 242 - neither is reliably 'us'

timing.hook_key_hold: 12 frames per press; MEASURED: at 30 fps that was 200 ms, at 120 fps 100 ms - this made menu presses stop registering when fps changed
timing.boot_wait: 48 s after launch before entry keys
timing.round_settle: the round does not accept input immediately after entering the arena; ~4 s settle was needed before binding succeeded

verified_pipeline.attest: python tools/attest.py -> 'VERDICT: ATTESTED' (room ok / bind ok / gate ok / opponent ok). Evidence in out/ATTESTED
verified_pipeline.gate: direction gate: hold D and require the bound instance to move right, hold A and require left; both must pass
verified_pipeline.doctor: python tools/doctor.py -> environment health (processes, priority, fps, room, file freshness, stale command file)

open: no verified round transition has ever been observed, so rounds_won is 0 and no win rate exists
the round counter in the reward cannot fire; fitness rests on net kills and territory only
menu navigation works but is slow (band capture + scroll per step)
